description: Get income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow data for a company. Supports annual, quarterly, and trailing-twelve-month views. Use when analyzing revenue, profitability, debt, or cash position.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods to return (1-40). Defaults to 8.

type.description: Financial period type: "annual", "quarter", or "ttm" (trailing twelve months). Defaults to annual.

name: get_financials
title: Get Financial Statements
